inclusion_criteria.text: Patient who completed surgery for his breast cancer and for which definitive histo-pathological analysis of surgical specimen is available.

logic.source_text: Patient who completed surgery for his breast cancer and for which definitive histo-pathological analysis of surgical specimen is available.

inclusion_criteria.text: Invasive breast carcinoma pN0 or pN(i+) with histological tumor size ≤ 10 mm (pT1a/b subgroup).
Invasive breast carcinoma with histological tumor size > 10 mm and ≤ 30 mm (pT1c T2 ≤ 30 mm control group).

conditions.source_text: histological tumor size > 10 mm and ≤ 30 mm (pT1c T2 ≤ 30 mm control group)

inclusion_criteria.text: Patient with HER2-negative breast carcinoma: immuno-histochemistry (IHC) score = 0, 1+ or 2+ and in situ hybridization (FISH, CISH, or SISH) negative (local laboratory testing).

conditions.source_text: immuno-histochemistry (IHC) score = 0, 1+ or 2+ and in situ hybridization (FISH, CISH, or SISH) negative (local laboratory testing)

inclusion_criteria.text: Patient with ER and PR negative invasive carcinoma (< 1% stained cells by immuno-histochemistry assay) (local laboratory testing).

conditions.source_text: < 1% stained cells by immuno-histochemistry assay (local laboratory testing)

inclusion_criteria.text: In case of multifocality, the histological size of the largest tumor must be ≤ 10 mm or ≤ 30 mm according to the inclusion subgroup.

logic.source_text: In case of multifocality, the histological size of the largest tumor must be ≤ 10 mm or ≤ 30 mm according to the inclusion subgroup.

inclusion_criteria.text: In case of multifocality, all lesions must be ER, PR and HER2-negative.

logic.source_text: In case of multifocality, all lesions must be ER, PR and HER2-negative.

inclusion_criteria.text: In case of breast conserving surgery, clear margins are required.

logic.source_text: In case of breast conserving surgery, clear margins are required.

inclusion_criteria.text: Patient affiliated to a Social Health Insurance in France.

logic.source_text: Patient affiliated to a Social Health Insurance in France.

inclusion_criteria.text: Patient information and written informed consent form signed prior to any study specific procedures.

logic.source_text: Patient information and written informed consent form signed prior to any study specific procedures.

exclusion_criteria.text: Patients with any previous malignancy of the breast or other site, with the exception of adequately treated basal or squamous cell carcinoma, non-melanomatous skin cancer totally resected.

logic.source_text: Patients with any previous malignancy of the breast or other site, with the exception of adequately treated basal or squamous cell carcinoma, non-melanomatous skin cancer totally resected.

exclusion_criteria.text: Non-invasive breast carcinoma (i.e. ductal carcinoma in situ exclusively).
Patients who received neo-adjuvant treatment (radiotherapy or chemotherapy or other before surgery).
